body:
## Goal
Publish `lino-arguments` to crates.io through **trusted publishing (OIDC)** instead of the long-lived `CARGO_TOKEN` / `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN` secrets. The organization `CARGO_TOKEN` is being retired and its current token expires soon.

## Why this repository needs review
`package-registry-manager setup --registry crates-io --migrate` (0.23.0) stopped here:

> no publishing jobs were found for migration

The release steps run `node scripts/publish-crate.mjs` with `CARGO_TOKEN`; the script builds `'cargo publish --allow-dirty'` as a string, which the tool does not recognise yet.

## Plan
1. In the two release jobs, add `id-token: write` and the pinned `rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action` before `node scripts/publish-crate.mjs`, and pass its token as `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN`. The script already prefers it.
1. Remove the workflow-level and step-level `secrets.CARGO_*` references.
1. Merge the converted workflow, then run `package-registry-manager setup --repository . --registry crates-io --migrate --execute`. It registers the trusted publisher (top-level workflow and environment) and deletes the token secrets after the first OIDC release.

Tool gap tracked in link-foundation/package-registry-manager#60. Once that issue is fixed, `--migrate` should do all of this automatically.

comments.body:
**Policy update (2026-10-13):** pipelines must support **both** trusted publishing and tokens: try trusted publishing (OIDC) first, and fall back to the token secret only when it is unavailable. So **keep** `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN` / `CARGO_TOKEN`, and change only the order:

```yaml
      - name: Authenticate with crates.io (trusted publishing)
        id: crates_auth
        uses: rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action@c6f97d42243bad5fab37ca0427f495c86d5b1a18 # v1.0.5
        continue-on-error: true   # fall back to the token below
      - name: Publish
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.crates_auth.outputs.token || secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN || secrets.CARGO_TOKEN }}
```

The job needs `id-token: write`; a reusable workflow also declares the two secrets as optional `workflow_call` secrets. Existing token preflights can stay; feed them the same expression after the auth step. Do not delete the token secrets after the first OIDC release. Tool default tracked in link-foundation/package-registry-manager#62.

title: Publish lino-arguments to crates.io through trusted publishing (remove CARGO_TOKEN)
